Definition: of uncertain origin; Chuzas, an officer of Herod:--Chuza.
BiblicalUsage: Chuzas manages Herod's household, and his wife Joanna travels with Jesus and supports His ministry from her own means. The steward of a king's house ends up tied to a household that serves a greater King.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gospel reaches into every household, even the palace staff, and no position puts a person beyond its reach.
